request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Rotwater Eel".

Creative brief
Name: Rotwater Eel
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A serpentine flanker that turns its swimming path into a delayed projectile wave.
Body and silhouette: Long curved eel with a broad jaw, leaf-like fins, and a segmented glowing spine.
Signature features: Algae beard, luminous back nodes, and a forked marshweed tail.
Palette and materials: Dark teal, rotten green, muddy yellow, and faint violet.
Movement personality: Slippery, weaving, and opportunistic.
Attack concept: Swims through the air or shallow water in an S-curve; its glowing back nodes detach afterward and travel outward from the path.
Directional details: The upper jaw has one pale fang on the right side.
Avoid: Skeletal zombie fish, realistic decay, extremely thin eel body.
